messages:
Anya (AE): Prospect wants BCP/DR proof for SIG: specific RTO/RPO, backup cadence, restore test evidence, failover steps, and exact SLA copy. Can we produce a short, exportable reply + a tiny runbook snippet?

Marcus (Security): I'll draft. Split Hosted vs Dedicated/Private and note encryption + KMS. Keep hosted conservative.

Ravi (SRE): Key bullets: control plane replicated cross-AZ; WAL shipping to geo-standby; object store snapshots hourly, nightly fulls; default retention 30d; quarterly full-restore drills. Caches ephemeral.

Marcus (Security): SIG-ready text (brief): Hosted — multi-AZ replication with geo-standby and encrypted snapshots. Target RTO (control plane) <= 1 hour; persisted-data RPO ~15 minutes (WAL + hourly snapshots). Dedicated/Private — RTO/RPO contract-configurable per SOW. Backups encrypted at rest (customer or Redwood KMS) and in transit (TLS).

Ravi (SRE): Failover summary: health checks + smart routing switch to healthy cluster; region loss triggers cross-region DNS failover and standby promotion. Routing switch ~1–5 minutes; full data restore time varies by dataset. Restore evidence: quarterly drill artifacts available (sanitized logs/screenshots) on request.

Claire (Legal): Suggested SLA blurb: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (see contract). Remedies and exclusions per SLA and SOW; no additional guarantees outside contractual terms."

Ravi (SRE): Runbook excerpt to attach:

```
Failover test excerpt
1) Notify #eng-oncall and set maintenance flag
2) Trigger routing to secondary region
3) Smoke: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api-secondary.redwood.ai/health
4) Validate replication lag <30s and sample requests
5) Re-sync primary from backups and monitor
Evidence: attach controller logs, screenshots, and runbook entry timestamp
```

DR Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/dr-tests/latest — last full restore 2025-07-02 (index #45).

Anya (AE): Thanks — I'll paste into the SIG spreadsheet and request scrubbed drill artifacts.

Marcus (Security): I'll pull and redact logs, upload within 24h.

Claire (Legal): LGTM. Reference SLA/SOW and avoid firm promises in SIG.

Anya (AE): Sending to customer, will update with any follow-ups.
